---
title: "Ion concentrations in Bisley, Puerto Rico streams before and after Hurricane Hugo"
format: html
---
## Background
This analysis sources and analyzes data from stream sites in Bisley Puerto Rico to replicate figure 3 in Schaefer et al. ([2000](https://doi.org/10.1017/s0266467400001358)).

## Data
The data were retrieved from the [Environmental Data Initiative](https://doi.org/10.6073/PASTA/F31349BEBDC304F758718F4798D25458). 

## Methods
The moving average of each ion concentration was calculated for each site in Bisley, Puerto Rico at 9 week intervals.

## Results
```{r, include = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
bisley_mov_ave_long <- read_csv("../output/bisley_mov_ave_long.csv")
ggplot(
  data = bisley_mov_ave_long,
  mapping = aes(
    x = window_start,
    y = concentration,
    color = site_id
  )
) +
  xlim(ymd("1988-01-01"), ymd("1994-06-01")) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ion,
    scales = "free_y",
    ncol = 1,
    strip.position = "left"
  ) +
  xlab("Year") +
  labs(
    subtitle = "Concentrations in Bisley, Puerto Rico streams before and after Hurricane Hugo, 9-wk moving averages from 1988 through 1994.
    (a) potassium, (b) nitrate-N, (c) magnesium, (d) calcium and (e) ammonium-N. The vertical lines mark 
    the time of hurricane disturbance."
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = ymd("1989-09-18"),
    linetype = "dashed"
  )
```
